item.title: Mitcad 0.70.0 reference snapshot
item.description:
This directory pins the exact upstream command reference used by the first Forge multi-backend feasibility work.

  • Mitcad release: v0.70.0
  • Upstream commit: 806a4210126ab977ba678708dd476496ddbd2968
  • Upstream command-reference blob: 40240776bc6885e228bf2fbd8e2534875aa61b85
  • Live MCP command-resource blob: c839084ba223e814370a55c761644da362fabc93
  • Runtime machine catalog: not yet checked in

Evidence

  • commands.md is byte-for-byte the upstream core/model-api/src/commands.md Git blob from v0.70.0.
  • It is the source included by Mitcad MCP as the basis of mitcad://reference/commands; the server filters entries its vocabulary does not permit, so the live resource has a separate pinned identity.
  • The exact v0.70.0 AppImage produced live resource blob c839084ba223e814370a55c761644da362fabc93 during #192 qualification.
  • modules/mitcad-reference can additionally capture the live model_reference catalog into commands.json and require the live command-resource text to retain this exact Git-blob identity.

This initial snapshot intentionally does not invent a machine catalog when a v0.70.0 mitcad-cli binary is not available in Forge CI. Add commands.json only by running the capture command against that exact CLI.
